description: A unary partial function is partial recursive under the finite-arity closure rules if and only if some paired program evaluates to that same partial function.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.MachinesAndComputationHistories.paired_program_iff {f : ℕ → Part ℕ} :
  (Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PartialRecursiveFunctions.Recursive fun v => f (List.Vector.get v 0)) ↔
    ∃ c, c.eval = f
